title: Open Side-Gusset Paper Shopping Bag
description: One original empty upright kraft-paper shopping bag visual prop. A continuous thin closed material shell has a complete rectangular flat bottom, broad planar front and rear sheets and two inward side gusset creases rising to a genuinely open concave-hexagonal mouth. Two separately editable flat U-shaped straps have open centres and four complete lower roots seated on the outside front/rear sheets. Three closed material meshes and two opaque matte untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, front -Y and centred grounded bottom. Newly authored folded-sheet form, not the old rounded soft travel holdall resized or the bottomless florist sleeve recoloured. Fixed empty pose only; no contents, print, animation, paper deformation, carrying/load capacity, wet strength, manufacturing or safety claim.
